word: Title: Afternoon At The Community Fair
answer: Tarde En La Feria Comunitaria

word: I generate a list of activities for the booth.
answer: "Genero una lista de actividades para el puesto."

word: You shout to call the kids for the game. [pl]
answer: "Gritan para llamar a los niños al juego."

word: We find a good spot for the table.
answer: "Hallamos un buen lugar para la mesa."

word: They identify the materials we still need.
answer: "Identifican los materiales que aún necesitamos."

word: I imagine how the booth will look finished.
answer: "Imagino cómo se verá el puesto terminado."

word: You involve your friends in decorating. [sing, inf]
answer: "Implicas a tus amigos en la decoración."

word: We import the music playlist.
answer: "Importamos la lista de música."

word: They incorporate more colors into the banner.
answer: "Incorporan más colores al cartel."

word: You indicate where to place the balloons. [sing, formal]
answer: "Indica dónde colocar los globos."

word: We install the lights around the booth.
answer: "Instalamos las luces alrededor del puesto."

word: They integrate the new volunteers into the team.
answer: "Integran a los nuevos voluntarios al equipo."

word: I try a different layout for the table.
answer: "Intento un acomodo diferente para la mesa."

word: You interest the visitors with your display. [pl]
answer: "Interesan a los visitantes con su exhibición."

word: We interpret the schedule to stay organized.
answer: "Interpretamos el horario para mantenernos organizados."

word: They invite families to join the next activity.
answer: "Invitan a las familias a unirse a la siguiente actividad."

word: You launch small prizes to the crowd. [sing, inf]
answer: "Lanzas pequeños premios al público."

word: We raise the banner so everyone can see it.
answer: "Levantamos la manta para que todos la vean."

word: They limit the number of participants per round.
answer: "Limitan el número de participantes por ronda."

word: I fill out the volunteer sheet.
answer: "Lleno la hoja de voluntarios."

word: You cry from excitement when the fair starts. [sing, formal]
answer: "Llora de emoción cuando empieza la feria."

word: We achieve a great turnout.
answer: "Logramos una gran participación."

word: They manifest their happiness with applause.
answer: "Manifestan su alegría con aplausos."

word: You mark the winners on the board. [pl]
answer: "Marcan a los ganadores en el tablero."

word: I tuck in the extra supplies under the table.
answer: "Meto los materiales extra debajo de la mesa."

word: We move the chairs for the next game.
answer: "Movemos las sillas para el siguiente juego."

word: They are going to install more lights later.
answer: "Van a instalar más luces más tarde."

word: You are going to generate more tickets soon. [sing, inf]
answer: "Vas a generar más boletos pronto."

word: We are going to celebrate after closing.
answer: "Vamos a celebrar después de cerrar."
